summary: GalaxyFarm is an application that addresses the issue of farmers being affected by weather changes. Our app uses NASA datasets and local sources to recommend the next steps on what farmers should do.
details: GalaxyFarm provides information such as precipitation, temperature ranges, and soil levels for the farmer's area. This information is then used for data analysis, providing monthly and annual recaps of temperature and precipitation, as well as soil composition and moisture. After this, the SERP API queries local sources to get new information about the area that NASA data does not contain to recommend a plan for what the farmer should do. The benefit is that the farmer does not have to spend time or resources to come up with a plan and can also fact-check data with the NASA Dataset and local sources. The purpose of this project is to help farmers achieve the best yield through our crop rotation assistant tool. We used Python and SerpAPI for our backend. We considered data not being recent so we added SerpAPI to monitor for any local changes that have not been documented and also we considered different factors in that area and not just temperature. The map feature allows the farmer to click the plot of land they are on or want to see the potential cost of moving into that field; this aspect is what makes it creative because any farmer can look at any land and see the cost and what they need to plant.
